brief:
A flotilla of Italian and Albanian pro-Palestinian activists arrived in the coastal city of Vlore to support the "Flamingo Revolution," a local protest movement opposing construction of a luxury resort, Middle East Eye reported. The activists traveled by sea to demonstrate solidarity with the opposition campaign.

The convergence of the pro-Gaza flotilla with Albania's environmental and community resistance illustrates how international Palestinian solidarity networks have begun aligning with local struggles against development projects. The "Flamingo Revolution" has mobilized opposition to the planned resort on environmental and preservation grounds, drawing backing from activist groups across the Mediterranean region.

title: Pro-Gaza activists sail to Albania backing anti-resort campaign
